description: Compute deterministic primality below 3.3 × 10^24 using the 13 prime Miller–Rabin bases through 41, plus complete factorization through 10^12 or a smallest factor through 10000. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

integer.description: Nonnegative decimal digits, 0 <= n < 3300000000000000000000000 (3.3 × 10^24), at most 25 digits. Full composite factorization through 10^12; otherwise smallest prime factor search through 10000 only.

name: prime_number_checker

outputSchema.description: Primality and classification, exact integer/factor strings, smallestFactor (null if unavailable), factors (null if incomplete), completeness note, witness set and formula.

title: Prime Number Checker
